title: sessionStorage
body:
Identical in API to [[localStorage]] — `setItem`, `getItem`, `removeItem`, string values, scoped to an [[Origin]] — with one difference: the data is scoped to a single **tab** and cleared when that tab closes. Opening the same site in a second tab gives you a completely separate sessionStorage.

Like localStorage, it is never automatically transmitted to the server; only your own JS can read it. Useful for things that should not survive the visit or leak between tabs: a multi-step form's in-progress state, a scroll position, a one-off redirect target. Don't confuse it with a [[Session Cookie]], which *is* auto-attached to requests and is shared across all tabs of the browser.
